ref.substituent_description: A CH carbon carries NHBoc (plain bond up) and MeOOC (hashed bond to the left) and is bonded to a CH2 that attaches to a benzene ring; the ring carries OPh at the para position relative to the CH2.
ref.notes: Typeset. Benzene drawn with three Kekule double bonds. The only stereo mark is the hashed bond to MeOOC.

wrong.substituent_description: A benzene ring (circle) has OPh at one position and a CH2 chain at a position meta to it (1,3). The chain is ring-CH2-CH, and the CH carries NHBoc (plain bond, pointing up) and MeOOC (hashed bond, pointing left).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The OO in MeOOC is overwritten and looks smudged
The hashed bond to MeOOC is drawn as a few vertical strokes with small ticks, so the hash count is rough
Ink is very dark purple-black on grey paper
wrong.notes: Handwritten drawing, photographed on grey paper. The ink looks dark purple or black, recorded as black. Small ink dots sit on some ring vertices.

correct.substituent_description: A para-disubstituted circled benzene: OPh on one ring carbon and, on the opposite (para) carbon, a CH2 that leads to a CH carrying NHBoc (on a plain bond going up) and MeOOC (on a hashed bond going left); i.e. Ar-CH2-CH(NHBoc)(MeOOC).
correct.notes: Handwritten black ink on white paper. The phenyl of OPh is written as the label Ph, not drawn as a ring. There is a dark smudge on a ring bond at the lower right of the benzene.

ref.substituent_description: Para-disubstituted benzene ring: OPh on one ring carbon and a CH2 on the carbon directly opposite (para). The CH2 connects to a stereocentre carbon that bears NHBoc (plain bond, upward) and MeOOC (hashed wedge bond, to the left).
ref.notes: Typeset. Hashed wedge runs from the stereocentre carbon to the MeOOC label.

wrong.substituent_description: A benzene ring (circle) bearing OPh at the top vertex and, at the lower-left vertex, a CH2 group: this is meta (1,3) to the OPh. The CH2 is bonded to a chain CH that carries NHBoc (vertical bond upward) and MeOOC (hashed bond to the lower left).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: hashed bond lines run right up against the C of MeOOC
the two O letters of MeOOC are heavily retraced
wrong.notes: Hashed bond is drawn as about five short parallel strokes from the chain CH to MeOOC. The chain is ring-CH2-CH(NHBoc)(MeOOC).

correct.substituent_description: A six-membered ring drawn as a hexagon with a small circle inside. It carries OPh at the upper-right vertex and, para to it (lower-left vertex), a CH2 vertex leading to a chain carbon. That chain carbon bears MeOOC through a hashed bond and is bonded by a plain line straight up to NHBoc (so the chain is ring-CH2-CH(MeOOC, hashed)-NHBoc).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The final C of MeOOC is written like an open 'c'/alpha shape and the OO look like open circles, so the label is read as MeOOC with slight doubt.
A dark ink blob sits on the lower-right ring vertex and could be mistaken for a wedge but looks like a pen blot.
The 'h' of OPh is written like a lowercase 'h' with a long ascender.
correct.notes: Handwritten, black pen on white paper. The aromatic ring is shown with a small hand-drawn circle (no alternating double bonds). The hashed bond is a set of about 5-6 short strokes between the stereocentre and MeOOC.
